question: What should be verified before adding AI discovery files?
direct_answer: Make the canonical page answer a real question with its qualifications and sources, then test whether another representation benefits a supported client.
original_contribution: A four-step HTML, rendered-page, and alternate-representation verification sequence; this is an ARWP proposal, not a ranking experiment.
useful_action: Inspect one deployed page and compare its extracted answer and qualifications across representations.

sources.support: Technical requirements require indexing and snippet eligibility for supporting links; SEO best practices include important textual content; additional AI files are unnecessary. No inclusion guarantee.
The standard allows application-private data-* attributes. ARWP attribute names and the verification workflow are original conventions, not a search standard.

claims.text: Google requires a page to be indexed and snippet-eligible to be considered as a supporting link in its AI search features; serving is not guaranteed.
Google says additional AI text files and special schema are unnecessary for its AI search features.
The HTML standard permits application-private data-* attributes.

publication_status: educational example only; example.com identity, noindex HTML; no external ranking experiment
